messages.subject: GCC Executive Introduction | Government Relations, ESG & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Abdul Rehman,

Your leadership of MSI across the GCC and your background in international development, retained search and senior recruitment make this a focused introduction for regional leadership opportunities.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder relations, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles across external affairs, government relations, ESG and sustainability, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and country operations. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, and I am internationally mobile for expatriate assignments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
